method: Dashboard SQL Editor SELECT; privileged catalog metadata only, not a user-authorization test
query: select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',now(),'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'args',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'service_execute',has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) order by p.proname) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname like 'permission_menu_image_%'),'uploads_table',to_regclass('private.menu_image_uploads')::text,'assets_table',to_regclass('private.menu_image_assets')::text,'withdrawal_trigger',(select count(*) from pg_trigger where tgname='permission_menu_image_withdrawal' and not tgisinternal),'buckets',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'public',public,'file_size_limit',file_size_limit,'mime_types',allowed_mime_types) order by id) from storage.buckets where id in('menu-item-images','menu-item-image-staging')),'storage_objects_policies',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',policyname,'command',cmd,'roles',roles,'using',qual,'check',with_check)) from pg_policies where schemaname='storage' and tablename='objects')) as image_inventory;

functions.args: p_item_id uuid, p_upload_handle uuid, p_mime_type text, p_byte_size bigint
functions.name: permission_menu_image_begin_upload
